Nora (AE): sharing Solaris POC redlines. procurement wants net45, PO-before-countersign, KMS/HSM attestation language, and a clause to wipe test data after the POC. attaching redline.
Diego - Legal: quick Q - is Solaris handling regulated data (PCI/HIPAA) or only PII? which Redwood entity will execute?
Nora (AE): only standard PII; Redwood US to sign. procurement explicitly asked for HSM attestation in the MSA.
Aisha (SE): technical note: Hosted supports customer-managed keys with a procedural attestation. HSM hardware attestation is only available on Dedicated with HSM-backed KMS. For Hosted we can provide SOC reports and a procedural attestation but not a hardware certificate.
Tom (Presales): option to offer a 30-day Dedicated trial for the POC — satisfies HSM attestation and gives tighter p95 latency. upsides: predictable perf; downsides: higher cost.
Marta (Finance): net45 OK for a POC if we receive PO and billing contact before countersign. invoices to be addressed to "Solaris AP" and first invoice after the first billing month.
Diego - Legal: redline hotspots: (1) SLA 1 they requested p95 inference latency <150ms for the POC (2) KMS indemnity/warranty language (3) subprocessor disclosure for embeddings vendor. we need a subprocessor list and data flow.
Nora (AE): the latency ask is aggressive at their projected qps (~25).
Aisha (SE): p95 150ms is realistic on Dedicated in our benchmarks; Hosted p95 will be higher. suggested compromise: commit to latency SLOs and include a Dedicated addendum for any firm p95 SLA, and an automatic routing fallback if latency degrades.
Diego - Legal: propose compromise language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet agreed latency SLOs; where Customer requires a firm p95 latency SLA, the parties will execute a Dedicated deployment addendum that sets forth the SLA and remedies." OK?
Nora (AE): procurement also requested signature routing: Procurement -> Customer Legal -> Redwood Exec, with countersign within 3 business days.
Marta (Finance): finance can expedite and use e-sign if PO and billing contact are provided in advance. we require PO number on the orderform for net45.
DocBot: ACTION ITEMS:
- Legal (Diego): draft MSA response with Dedicated-addendum fallback and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- SE (Aisha): provide perf matrix and Dedicated trial cost estimate (ETA EOD).
- Sales (Nora): obtain PO, billing contact, and signer names from Solaris procurement (ETA today).
- Finance (Marta): prepare invoice flow and confirm net45 terms on orderform (ETA EOD).
Tom (Presales): I'll draft a one-pager Hosted vs Dedicated for the POC (latency, cost delta, attestation differences).
Nora (AE): pinged Solaris procurement and cc'd @Tom to offer Dedicated trial. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan.
Diego - Legal: :thumbsup:
Aisha (SE): :thumbsup:
Marta (Finance): :thumbsup:
Tom (Presales): :thumbsup:
Nora (AE): thanks 1 will update once PO and signer info arrive.
